description: CLF-017 fail: a second claimant with the same number and short name has already pushed a branch of OUR name (an unrelated commit), so our push is rejected as a non-fast-forward and there is no numeric rival. A branch of our name at another commit is not our push: it is not read as landed, and the claim is refused as the rejected push it is, exit 1, instead of being reported as made. Differs from the pass direction only in that foreign branch.

.specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-f: # Fixture stub of .specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1. The contract scripts/claim-feature.ps1 reads:
# it is called as -Json -Number N -ShortName S <description>, must create branch NNN-S and specs/NNN-S/ and
# leave that branch checked out, and must print {"BRANCH_NAME":"NNN-S"} on stdout.
# A second claimant with the same number AND the same short name has already pushed this very branch name (an unrelated commit).
# Git's hints about a rejected push vary by version; the fixture switches them off so the expectation does not.
